subject: Octopus
observations: Current Qwen-edited source visibly preserves eight separately traceable arms: four endpoints on the left and four on the right. Each arm has one large coral inner panel; two visible eyes and a smile complete a coherent face.

Purple body, coral arm panels, yellow sailor hat, blue hat band, orange starfish, green seaweed and turquoise shell supply seven meaningful contrasting color families. Adjacent seaweed greens and starfish shading are not extra palette credit.
Eight separate large coral panels provide excellent repeated number/color matching. Seaweed sections and broad hat, starfish and shell areas add variation without miniature clutter.

This retains the recognizable eight-arm silhouette of the original while materially improving color and region engagement to the user-approved benchmark level. Shell ribs are open decorative strokes, not assumed to be separate enclosed paint regions.
processed_gate_checks: Preserve all eight coral panels as useful numbered regions and confirm number room in the blue hat band.
Avoid tiny regions from starfish shading, narrow seaweed divisions, shell ribs and soft edge halos.
method: Individual current image visually inspected with view_image; decisions consider substantial contrasting colors, meaningful repeated regions, anatomy and cleanliness against user-approved 35/37 benchmarks.
scope: Source-image visual gate for this exact hash only. PASS permits processor evaluation; it does not approve extracted regions, final number placement, gameplay assets or video.
